Ayant is a single feed of what is happening in your city and a platform for getting discounts. We removed all the noise and kept only what really matters to you.
What you’ll find inside
All the key information from the city’s venues, organised by the **SAN** system:
S — Sales:
current price drops.
A — Promos:
special and limited offers.
N — New:
fresh arrivals, new menus and services.
Important announcements:
schedule changes and updates.
Each venue’s profile also has all the reference information: exact address, contacts and social links.
How to collect and spend bonuses
The app has its own bonus system you can collect without any extra effort:
Mini-games:
play right in the app and get bonuses for it.
Inviting friends:
share your referral link and collect bonuses together.
**What can you spend them on?** Collected bonuses are exchanged for coupons that give exclusive discounts at partner venues.
No spam, no ads and no extra buttons. Just SAN, venues and your savings. Everything you need in one app. Enjoy!
Privacy policy
What is SAN?
It is the core of our app. SAN is a feed where venues publish only three kinds of news: Sales, Promos and New items. No spam, only what matters.
Why are there games in the app?
It is an easy way to earn bonuses. You play short mini-games right inside the app, and we credit bonus points to your balance.
How does inviting friends (referrals) work?
Copy your unique link in your profile and send it to a friend. As soon as they sign up, both you and your friend get welcome bonuses.
What can I spend my bonuses on?
Bonuses can be exchanged for coupons inside the app. These coupons give discounts at partner venues.
How do I use a coupon at a venue?
Choose the coupon you want, exchange your bonuses for it and show the coupon screen to a venue employee (waiter, cashier, administrator) before paying.
Is the app free?
Yes, the app is completely free for users. There are no hidden subscriptions or paid features.
What if a venue refuses to accept a coupon, or the information in SAN doesn’t match reality?
We keep the data up to date, but if you run into such a problem, write to us in the “Support” section with the venue name. We will sort it out quickly.
Didn’t find an answer in the FAQ? Write to us — we’ll help quickly.
